d:
All of these paintings were extracted from the game's assets.
If you find any broken or incorrect paintings, please leave a comment to let me know.
The facial expressions used are the default ones, if there are special requests, I can add other expressions as well.
The paintings are sorted according to the asset names in the AssetBundle folder.
You can press Ctrl + F with the painting name to find the skin name in:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AzurLaneTools/AzurLaneData/main/EN/ShareCfg/ship_skin_template.json
Updated up to June 14, 2026.
